subject: economics
objective: How responsive is quantity to a price change?
instruction: Southfield compares two ways of measuring the same response: At a price of USD 25 the quantity demanded is 800 units; after the price changes to USD 30 the quantity demanded is 640 units. Use the midpoint (arc) method: percentage change = change / average of the two values. Price elasticity of demand = percentage change in quantity / percentage change in price, reported as a positive number (absolute value). Revenue = price x quantity. Point elasticity from the start = (change in Q / Q1) / (change in P / P1). Required: percentage change quantity, percentage change price, price elasticity of demand, point elasticity from start.
